prompt.generated_prompt_string: A candid-style professional photograph of a clearly adult brunette woman at a fictional high-fashion event appearance, vertical full-length portrait with the subject sharply in focus and a softly blurred urban background. She has long straight brunette hair with a middle part and minimal face-framing strands, luminous natural makeup, subtle shimmering eyeshadow, natural pink lips, and calm main-character presence. She wears a bridal-inspired strapless white gown with an intricate lace bodice, fully lined structure, voluminous textured skirt, and ruffled or floral-patterned fabric, plus a luxury diamond statement necklace and matching diamond drop earrings. Use a busy urban setting with softly blurred people and vehicles but no recognizable public figures, logos, or event branding. Bright soft diffused light at approximately 5200K enhances fabric texture, facial glow, and jewelry sparkle. Shoot with an 85mm fashion lens, realistic skin and lace detail, restrained dewy highlights, subtle grain, and elegant ethereal luxury mood. Use an approved adult model rather than a public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, recognizable public figures, real event logos, transparent fabric, visible intimate areas, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, illegible text artifacts
